description: Source file implementing utility functions for manipulating disk cache entries, including creating corrupt files, removing or corrupting SHA256 hashes, and corrupting stream length in cache entry files.

methods.name: CreateCorruptFileForTests
methods.description: Creates a dummy cache file with specified key in the cache directory.

methods.name: RemoveKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Removes the SHA256 hash flag from a cache entry file.

methods.name: CorruptKeySHA256FromEntry
methods.description: Overwrites the SHA256 hash in a cache entry file with corrupt data.

methods.name: CorruptStream0LengthFromEntry
methods.description: Sets the stream size in a cache entry file to an invalid large value.
